name: PTBot
author: jacoknapp
description: A Discord bot that lets you manage your Pterodactyl servers directly from Discord. Supports slash commands for server control, status checks, and console commands.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -e

# Create data directory
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data

# jq is required for safe JSON construction (escapes special chars in secrets)
apk add --no-cache jq >/dev/null 2>&1

# Helper: convert comma-separated string to a JSON array string via jq
to_json_array() {
  val="$1"
  val_stripped=$(echo "$val" | tr -d ' \t\r\n')
  if [ -z "$val_stripped" ]; then
    echo '[]'
    return
  fi
  # Split on comma, trim whitespace, emit as JSON array
  echo "$val_stripped" | tr ',' '\n' | sed 's/^ *//;s/ *$//' | grep -v '^$' \
    | jq -Rcs '[split("\n")[] | select(length>0)]'
}

AGJ=$(to_json_array "$ALLOWED_GUILD_IDS")
ARJ=$(to_json_array "$ALLOWED_ROLE_IDS")
AUJ=$(to_json_array "$ALLOWED_USER_IDS")

# Write config.json using jq so all string values are safely escaped
echo 'Creating default config.json...'
jq -n \
  --arg discord_token "$DISCORD_TOKEN" \
  --arg ptero_base_url "$PTERO_BASE_URL" \
  --arg ptero_client_token "$PTERO_CLIENT_TOKEN" \
  --arg alert_channel_id "$ALERT_CHANNEL_ID" \
  --arg health_check_interval "${HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL:-2m}" \
  --argjson allowed_guild_ids "$AGJ" \
  --argjson allowed_role_ids "$ARJ" \
  --argjson allowed_user_ids "$AUJ" \
  '{
    discord_token: $discord_token,
    ptero_base_url: $ptero_base_url,
    ptero_client_token: $ptero_client_token,
    alert_channel_id: $alert_channel_id,
    health_check_interval: $health_check_interval,
    allowed_guild_ids: $allowed_guild_ids,
    allowed_role_ids: $allowed_role_ids,
    allowed_user_ids: $allowed_user_ids
  }' > /mnt/server/data/config.json

echo 'PTBot installation completed.'
